named_falsifiable_mechanism.finding: Test incremental post-publication BTC return information from institution-category option positioning beyond historical prices and futures positioning; predictive association is not causal flow or demonstrated net profit.

difference_from_closed_routes.finding: Regulator category positions, not expiry flow, inferred dealer Gamma, ETF daily creations, carry, price-only trend, or ETH/SOL residual reversion. No closed route reopened.

complete_cost_and_exit_model.finding: Bybit BTCUSDT single leg with fees, spread, impact, latency, signed funding, partial fills and residual exits required; current fee illustration known but path-specific executable bounds unbound.

development_and_independent_input_identi.finding: Official report sources and delayed release notices identified; complete target release clocks not bound. New COT input does not restore independence to consumed BTC returns. No new independent historical domain certified.

frozen_learning_algorithm_and_reference.finding: Candidate comparison would add institution option information to a same-clock price-and-futures reference. Complete equations, training scope and selection procedure not frozen; no claim to replicate the paper or permission to train.

same_research_and_delivery_semantics.finding: CME nearby-futures results cannot substitute for Bybit perpetual fills. Existing native replay is reusable, but this candidate has no executed model-to-runtime parity verification.

performance_alert_trigger_and_recovery_p.finding: New policy separates performance from hard risk; candidate trigger and recovery not selected. Existing locks and risk rules remain unchanged.

minimum_economic_effect_and_units.finding: Needs cost-net equity return per fixed reporting block and economically meaningful absolute and incremental effects; no observed or assumed d is promoted to a market estimate.

dependence_and_tail_assumptions.finding: Weekly reports, overlapping positions and catch-up release clusters cannot be treated as independent daily samples. No calibrated dependence, tail or stopped-path model available.

familywise_selection_and_monitoring_poli.finding: One mechanism in this review; no economic selection or interim profit test. Project search history is not reset. A new full experiment still needs selection-aware fixed-endpoint or valid sequential rules.

false_admission_limit_and_minimum_power.finding: 5 percent alpha and 80 percent power apply only to the explicitly idealized planning calculation; no market-calibrated qualification power claimed.

event_capacity_and_final_endpoint.finding: At most one ordinary reporting date per week does not identify independent events. No qualified historical capacity or bounded forward endpoint; no observation scheduled.

total_resource_budget_and_negative_exit.finding: This admission review is bounded to 90 minutes and 24 document operations, zero economic attempts. No full research/maintenance/confirmation budget activated; insufficient complete scope ends this review without second candidate.
